policy.readAt: HEAD of the Syzygy commit above

screen: buildDossierScreen(policy, projectDocumentation enabled, the repository and commit as placement subject, visibility public)
method: blobless depth-1 fetch of one commit; git ls-tree -r -z --full-tree; screenPath and contentClass per blob path; withheldCensus with no per-project statement; cat-file --batch-all-objects confirms no blob object

outcomes.admittedCodeContent: the screen admits the path as code-content
outcomes.admittedProjectDocumentation: the screen admits the path as project-documentation
outcomes.admittedGovernanceText: the screen admits the path as governance-text
outcomes.withheldDeniedPath: a denied-path rule names it and no secret detector matches the path
outcomes.withheldSecretPath: a secret detector matches the path (counted, never named)
outcomes.indeterminateUnknownExtractionClass: no denied-path rule and no content class: the path is withheld as unknown-extraction-class

denominator: files: every tree entry with a blob mode the dossier reader lists (100644, 100755, 120000) at the commit; the six outcome counts sum to it; nonBlobEntries counts the rest (submodules)
classGateWithoutStatement: of the admitted paths, how many the class gate withholds from agent-bound artifacts when a run relies on no per-project statement (every class but code-content)

secondMethod.how: a separate blobless depth-1 fetch of the commit; git ls-tree -r (no -l) listed; grep -c -F " blob " counted the blobs; a Python filter counted blob paths ending in one of the policy's 25 code-content sourceExtensions (read with jq from the policy file, not through the screen), and none of those paths is named by a deniedPathBasenames, deniedPathPrefixes or deniedPathSuffixes entry
